name: Remotion (React)
license: Remotion License (free for individuals and small teams; company license for larger companies)
scaffold: use the Vidbucks templates: core/src/templates (copy a config in demos.ts) or write a new composition in core/src
stills: cd core && npx remotion still src/index.ts <CompositionId> out/qa/f.png --frame N --scale 0.35
render: cd core && npx remotion render src/index.ts <CompositionId> out/x.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --concurrency=4
notes: Four config-driven templates ship with Vidbucks: IconStory, ObjectStory, KineticType, ParticleBloom.
